author: nickyeow

english.text: He has not come yet. Something may have happened to him.

jyutping: keoi5 zung6 mei6 dou3 aa3，m4 zi1 hai6 mai6 faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 me1 ji3 ngoi6 ne1？
text: 佢仲未到呀，唔知係咪發生咗啲咩意外呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I feel like going out rather than staying at home today.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1，m4 soeng2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2。
text: 我今日想出街，唔想留喺屋企。

author: Riko

english.text: Please wait half an hour.

jyutping: m4 goi1 dang2 saam1 sap6 fan1 zung1。
text: 唔該等三十分鐘。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Our teacher said that water boils at 100°C.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 go3 lou5 si1 waa6 seoi2 dou3 zo2 jat1 baak3 dou6 zau6 wui5 gwan2。
text: 我哋個老師話水到咗一百度就會滾。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't have a cat.

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 joeng5 maau1。
text: 我冇養貓。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Aren't you supposed to be at school today?

jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6 me1？
text: 你今日唔使返學咩？

author: nickyeow

english.text: We have lots of things to do.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 zou6。
text: 我哋有好多嘢要做。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't tell Father about this.

jyutping: m4 hou2 gong2 ne1 gin6 si6 bei2 aa3 baa4 teng1。
text: 唔好講呢件事俾阿爸聽。

author: kaenif

english.text: The boys do not sit on benches in the garden, but lie on the soft grass.

jyutping: di1 naam4 zai2 m4 zo6 faa1 jyun2 di1 coeng4 dang3，zau6 fan3 hai2 di1 jyun5 cou2 soeng6 min6。
text: 啲男仔唔坐花園啲長櫈，就瞓喺啲軟草上面。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom bought a camera like yours.

jyutping: Tom maai5 zo2 bou6 soeng2 gei1 hou2 ci5 nei5 go2 bou6。
text: Tom買咗部相機好似你嗰部。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've done what I can for you.

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 wai4 nei5 zou6 ge3 dou1 zou6 zo2 laa3。
text: 我可以為你做嘅都做咗喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom reached into his pocket and pulled out a handful of coins.

jyutping: aa3 Tom san1 zo2 zek3 sau2 lok6 go3 doi2 dou3，ling1 zo2 gei2 go3 ngan2 zai2 ceot1 lai4。
text: 阿Tom伸咗隻手落個袋到，拎咗幾個銀仔出嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She is still financially dependent on her parents.

jyutping: keoi5 zung6 jiu3 man6 keoi5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1 lo2 cin2。
text: 佢仲要問佢阿爸阿媽攞錢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This sentence is grammatically incorrect.

jyutping: ne1 geoi3 geoi3 zi2 man4 faat3 m4 ngaam1。
text: 呢句句子文法唔啱。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Be careful not to step in the mud.

jyutping: siu2 sam1 aa3，m4 hou2 caai2 lok6 di1 nai4 dou3。
text: 小心呀，唔好踩落啲泥到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla will never make it.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 sing4 gung1。
text: 蕾拉永遠都唔會成功。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We don't have much snow here even in the winter.

jyutping: nei1 dou3 lin4 dung1 tin1 dou1 m4 hai6 lok6 hou2 do1 syut3。
text: 呢到連冬天都唔係落好多雪。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: The teacher told me that Hitler killed himself.

jyutping: lou5 si1 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 hei1 dak6 lak6 zi6 saat3 zo2 laa3。
text: 老師話畀我知希特勒自殺咗喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Overrated, yes, but it is a good manga.

jyutping: hai6，di1 jan4 hai6 pung2 keoi5 pung2 dak1 kwaa1 zoeng1 zo2 di1，daan6 hai6 ni1 go3 maan6 waa2 hai6 m4 co3 gaa3 bo3。
text: 係，啲人係捧佢捧得誇張咗啲，但係呢個漫畫係唔錯㗎啵。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm not good enough.

jyutping: ngo5 mei6 gau3 ging6。
text: 我未夠勁。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom spoke to the pastor for two hours.

jyutping: aa3 Tom tung4 go3 muk6 si1 king1 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 gai3。
text: 阿Tom同個牧師傾咗兩個鐘計。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I take it from your silence that you are not satisfied with my answer.

jyutping: nei5 lap1 seng1 m4 ceot1，ze1 hai6 m4 mun5 ji3 ngo5 ge3 daap3 on3 laa1。
text: 你粒聲唔出，啫係唔滿意我嘅答案啦。

author: clowergen

english.text: Are you a new student?

jyutping: nei5 hai6 mai5 san1 hok6 saang1 lai4 gaa3？
text: 你係咪新學生嚟㗎？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: The employees are protesting against the job cuts.

jyutping: jyun4 gung1 wai6 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 ji4 kong3 ji5。
text: 員工為公司裁員而抗議。

english.text: So I just learned from a post on Facebook that the account that I thought wasn't working got hacked, some bad stuff happened, and it got banned. I was on vacation, so I had no idea this had transpired, and I hope that by posting this here, I can clear up that I didn't have anything to do with that, but I'd like to know who did.

jyutping: so2 ji5 ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 Facebook ge3 jat1 go3 tip3 zi2 jap6 min6 zi1 dou3，ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 work ge3 zoeng3 wu6 bei2 haak1 haak3 jap6 cam1，faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 m4 hou2 ge3 si6，ji4 ce2 keoi5 bei6 gam3 zi2，so2 ji5 ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 ni1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 zo2，ngo5 hei1 mong6 hai6 gam2 hai2 nei1 dou6 faat3 bou3 ni1 go3，ngo5 ho2 ji5 cing1 co2 ngo5 tung4 go2 gin6 si6 mou5 jam6 ho4 gwaan1 hai6，daan6 ngo5 soeng2 zi1 bin1 go3 jau5 gwaan1 hai6。
text: 所以我啱啱喺 Facebook 嘅一個帖子入面知道，我覺得唔 work 嘅帳戶畀黑客入侵，發生咗啲唔好嘅事，而且佢被禁止，所以我完全唔知呢件事發生咗，我希望係咁 喺呢度發佈呢個，我可以清楚我同嗰件事冇任何關係，但我想知邊個有關係。

english.text: Few people, we're sure, have ever seen carved eggshells. These have no relationship to eggs that are painted or decorated with gems or other jewels, like Faberge's famous eggs, which weren't even eggs. One artist in the Washington D.C. area is delicately sculpting on eggshells. Her eggshells are seen frequently in local art galleries. Our reporter spent time with Tina Kannapel and her cats — mostly not walking on eggshells.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hang2 ding6 hou2 siu2 jan4 gin3 gwo3 diu1 hak1 ge3 daan2 hok3，ni1 di1 tung4 waa6 zo2 waak6 ze2 jung6 bou2 sek6 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 zyu1 bou2 zong1 sik1 ge3 daan2 mou5 mat1 gwaan1 hai6，hou2 ci5 faat3 bui3 git6 ge3 zyu3 ming4 daan6，keoi5 dei6 lin4 daan6 dou1 m4 hai6 waa4 sing6 deon6 dak6 keoi1 ge3 jat1 wai6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 hai6 hai2 daan2 hok3 soeng6 min6 sai3 zi3 gam3 diu1 hak1 gan2 keoi5 ge3 daan2 hok3 ging1 soeng4 hai2 dong1 dei6 ge3 ngai6 seot6 gun2 gin3 dou2。
text: 我哋肯定好少人見過雕刻嘅蛋殼，呢啲同畫咗或者用寶石或者其他珠寶裝飾嘅蛋冇乜關係，好似法貝傑嘅著名蛋，佢哋連蛋都唔係華盛頓特區嘅一位藝術家 係喺蛋殼上面細緻咁雕刻緊佢嘅蛋殼經常喺當地嘅藝術館見到。

author: Gearhulk

english.text: What do you want to get him for his birthday?

jyutping: keoi5 saang1 jat6 nei5 soeng2 maai5 mat1 je5 bei2 keoi5？
text: 佢生日你想買乜嘢畀佢？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "You know, I suppose, that they raise pa'sons there like radishes in a bed? And though it do take—how many years, Bob?—five years to turn a lirruping hobble-de-hoy chap into a solemn preaching man with no corrupt passions, they'll do it, if it can be done, and polish un off like the workmen they be, and turn un out wi' a long face, and a long black coat and waistcoat, and a religious collar and hat, same as they used to wear in the Scriptures, so that his own mother wouldn't know un sometimes."

jyutping: 「nei5 zi1 m4 zi1，ngo5 nam2，keoi5 dei6 hai2 go2 dou6 joeng5 paak3 sam1，zau6 hou2 ci5 hai2 cong4 soeng6 ge3 lo4 baak6 gam2？seoi1 jin4 jiu3 —— gei2 do1 nin4，baau1 but6？ —— ng5 nin4 si4 gaan3 sin1 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 jat1 go3 laan5 joeng4 joeng4 ge3 ban6 daan2 bin3 sing4 jat1 go3 jim4 suk1 ge3 cyun4 dou6 jan4，mou5 fu6 baai6 ge3 gik1 cing4，daan6 jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 zou6 dou3 ge3 waa2，keoi5 dei6 wui5 zou6 dou3，tung4 maai4 hou2 ci5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 jan4 gam2 dam2 saai3，jin4 hau6 hou2 ci5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 jan4 gam2 dam2 saai3，zoi3 zoek6 jat1 gin6 coeng4、hak1 sik1 ge3 ngoi6 tou3 tung4 jat1 gin6 zung1 gaau3 ge3 ngoi6 tou3 tung4 maai4 mou2，tung4 keoi5 dei6 hai2 ging1 man4 jap6 min6 daai3 ge3 jat1 joeng6，dang2 keoi5 zi6 gei2 aa3 maa1 jau5 si4 m4 wui5 zi1 dou3。」
text: 「你知唔知，我諗，佢哋喺嗰度養帕森，就好似喺床上嘅蘿蔔噉？雖然要 —— 幾多年，鮑勃？ —— 五年時間先可以將一個懶洋洋嘅笨蛋變成一個嚴肅嘅傳道人，冇腐敗嘅激情，但如果可以做到嘅話，佢哋會做到，同埋好似佢哋嘅工人噉抌晒，然後好似佢哋嘅工人噉抌晒，再着一件長、黑色嘅外套同一件宗教嘅外套 同埋帽，同佢哋喺經文入面戴嘅一樣，等佢自己阿媽有時唔會知道。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: “What I want is not a word, which is blown away as soon as I speak it. What I want is not the fennel which always bends in the wind. What I want is as I dreamed it and that cannot be held by the hands. Just like the rising sun that the eyes cannot look at” said playwright MoḥYa.

jyutping: kek6 zok3 gaa1 MoḥYa waa6：「ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 zi6，jat1 gong2 zau6 wui5 bei6 ceoi1 zau2。ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 m4 hai6 go2 zung2 wing5 jyun5 hai2 fung1 zung1 waan1 kuk1 ge3 wui4 hoeng1。ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 hai6 ngo5 faat3 mung6 ge3，ji4 m4 hai6 jung6 sau2 pou5 zyu6 ge3。zau6 hou2 ci5 deoi3 ngaan5 mong6 m4 dou2 ge3 ziu1 joeng4 jat1 joeng6。」kek6 zok3 gaa1 MoḥYa waa6。
text: 劇作家MoḥYa話：「我想要嘅唔係一個字，一講就會被吹走。我想要嘅唔係嗰種永遠喺風中彎曲嘅茴香。我想要嘅係我發夢嘅，而唔係用手抱住嘅。就好似對眼望唔到嘅朝陽一樣。」劇作家MoḥYa話。
